g.title: crate A text input's lines, shaped as they are needed and kept in step with its edits.
crate::chunks Hard-line splits, chunk reconciliation and byte/scalar/UTF16 lookup.
crate::edit_lines `EditLines`: the retained, lazily shaped lines of one text input.
crate::excerpt Bounded IME excerpts cut at grapheme and CRLF boundaries.
crate::integrity Compare retained editing chunks with a full split of the displayed text.
crate::line_metrics Line height of a text style and a line's vertical offset in its row.
crate::pieces A long line shaped in pieces of under 64 KiB, joined into one line.
crate::records Passive line, chunk, cache-key and prefix records.
crate::refresh Explicit incremental reconciliation and debug integrity checkpoints.
crate::shaping Lazy shaping, editing geometry, coloring and bounded run publication.
